title: VidLBEval: Benchmarking and Mitigating Language Bias in Video-Involved LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using the VidLBEval benchmark through two tasks: Ambiguous Video Contrast (AVC), which measures pairwise prediction consistency across original and relevant or distorted video pairs to see if models ignore visual context, and Interrogative Question Probing (IQP), which uses follow-up binary questions to test the model's logical consistency and reliance on textual priors over visual evidence.
